rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:5142:details:0: So many of us died at the ⟦E12⟧ of Darrowshire. So many died... and worse.
rows.quest:5142:details:1: When the ⟦E12⟧ began I hid my niece Pamela, and I do not know what happened to her. I am but a wandering spirit, but my heart still longs to know Pamela's fate.
rows.quest:5142:details:2: Please, good ⟦22⟧. Will you go to Darrowshire and search for her? It is to the east, beyond Gahrron's Withering.
rows.quest:5142:completion:0: Hello. I'm Pamela, what's your name?
rows.quest:5149:details:0: My auntie Marlene told me to stay here in our house because my father had to go and fight. My father's the bravest man in the whole world!
rows.quest:5149:details:1: But I've been here for a long time, and he hasn't come for me. Sometimes bad people come and whisper to me and I want my dad to make them go away, but he's not here!
rows.quest:5149:details:2: And sometimes when it gets dark I want to play with my doll but I can't because I left it in town.
rows.quest:5149:details:3: Will you find my doll for me?
rows.quest:5149:completion:0: You found it! You found my doll! Oh, thank you!
rows.quest:5211:obj:0: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.
rows.quest:5211:details:0: Many of the defenders fell at the ⟦E12⟧ of Darrowshire. And many roam again as the ghastly servants of the Scourge! Find these poor souls and end their misery!
rows.quest:5211:details:1: Hunt cannibal ghouls, gibbering ghouls and diseased flayers. Many of these fiends were once the good folk of Darrowshire and destroying their forms now will set their souls free.
rows.quest:5211:details:2: You will find them in Plaguewood and Corin's Crossing, and in other Scourge strongholds of ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:5211:progress:0: The poor defenders of Darrowshire cry out to me in my dreams, ⟦23⟧. You must free them!
rows.quest:5211:completion:0: It is good to hear you found the tortured souls of my brethren and freed them. My heart will weep less, knowing at least some of the defenders of Darrowshire no longer wallow in the vile subservience of the Scourge.
rows.quest:5503:completion:0: All who fight evil on behalf of the ⟦E2⟧ must don our commission. Wearing such will earn your right to claim rewards our quartermasters have to offer.
rows.quest:5503:completion:1: While under commission, you'll be able to acquire Scourgestones from slain Scourge; these are marks of insignia that they sometimes possess. Procure these insignia and bring them to me. For each set you turn in, you will receive our marker of heroism - the ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:5503:completion:2: Achieve your destiny, ⟦24⟧ join the fight today!
rows.quest:5601:details:0: I fled Lordaeron during the great war, and was lucky to escape before the Scourge swept through my homeland and turned it into a plagued nightmare! I was lucky, but my family was not. I ⟦E15⟧ they were all killed during the ⟦E12⟧ of Darrowshire.
rows.quest:5601:details:1: Darrowshire is a village in the ⟦E16⟧, nestled in the southern hills of what is now the ⟦E13⟧. Will you go there and search for my family? I ⟦E17⟧ them so much, especially my little sister Pamela.
rows.quest:5601:completion:0: Where is my sister Jessica? She left so long ago, when I was just a little girl. She cried so much when she went away. I don't know why she cried! Maybe she fell and ⟦E18⟧ her toe.
rows.quest:5601:completion:1: When Jessica was here we used to play games and dance and pick pretty flowers around the house. And sometimes we'd hide when we saw daddy coming home, then jump out and surprise him!
rows.quest:5601:completion:2: Come back, Jessica! If you come back then maybe daddy will too and we can all play together again...
rows.quest:6021:details:0: Can you believe that, after all the trouble we have in the plaguelands... we have to worry about thieves too? And not just normal thieves, troll thieves.
rows.quest:6021:details:1: And not just normal troll thieves. Dead troll thieves!
rows.quest:6021:details:2: They're led by this big, dead troll named ⟦E21⟧, and they come here at night and steal bodies from the pit below, then take them back to their evil, dead troll hideout--the Undercroft to the west.
rows.quest:6021:details:3: Go there and take out Zaeldarr, ⟦25⟧. I'm sick to death of his mischief!
rows.quest:6021:progress:0: Did you find the hideout, ⟦26⟧? Did you take care of Zaeldarr?
rows.quest:6021:completion:0: Great, you got him! And I hope you taught his gang a lesson too!
rows.quest:6164:obj:0: Bring ⟦E22⟧ to ⟦E23⟧ the Touched in Terrordale.
rows.quest:6164:details:0: I'm ready for business! What you do want?
rows.quest:6164:details:1: Oh wait... I can't open up shop without my receipt book. How am I to keep track of things without my receipt book?
rows.quest:6164:details:2: I must have left it in town somewhere. I had a room in the inn... the book must be there.
rows.quest:6164:details:3: Bring me my book. Please, bring it to me! Bring me my book and you'll see! I'll set up shop and you'll see that my prices are INSANE!
rows.quest:6164:progress:0: Do you have my receipt book? I can't wait to get back to business!
rows.quest:6164:completion:0: There it is! And oh my! I forgot how full it was!
rows.quest:6164:completion:1: This is a glorious day, ⟦27⟧! Stupendous! Insanely good, I say!
rows.quest:9125:title: ⟦E24⟧
rows.quest:9125:progress:0: You did an exemplary job on the first bundle, ⟦28⟧. If you have more, I will take them now. For every bundle that you turn in, I will reward you with another insignia.
rows.quest:9125:completion:0: Most excellent, ⟦29⟧! These will definitely come to good use.
rows.quest:9127:title: ⟦E25⟧
rows.quest:9127:progress:0: A man in my line of work can never have too many bone fragments, ⟦30⟧. Whenever you have a surplus of fragments, bring them to me and I'll reward you with another insignia.
rows.quest:9127:completion:0: My dream of becoming a full-time dancer at the Gadgetzan disco is soon to become a reality! Keep up the good work, ⟦31⟧.
rows.quest:9129:title: ⟦E26⟧
rows.quest:9129:progress:0: Truth be told, I use the cores to create Frostfire ⟦E27⟧. It is the ⟦E27⟧ used by the mages battling in ⟦E28⟧. Without you and others like you, we would most definitely be losing this war.⟦32⟧⟦33⟧With that said, bring me more cores and I shall grant you more insignias.
rows.quest:9129:completion:0: You perform a great service for us, ⟦34⟧. Well done!
rows.quest:9132:title: ⟦E29⟧
rows.quest:9132:progress:0: For every armful of the scraps, I'll give you an insignia - the more the better. Now get out of my sight before I split you in two!
rows.quest:9132:completion:0: That's all you brought me? Maybe you didn't hear me the first time. I need MORE!
rows.quest:9137:title: Savage Fronds
rows.quest:9137:progress:0: For every bundle of fronds that you deliver to me, I will pay you with your choice of an insignia of the Dawn or the Crusade.⟦35⟧⟦36⟧Insignias may be turned in to the Quartermaster for various rewards.
rows.quest:9137:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦37⟧. Your work is vital to the success of our campaign against the Scourge.

rows.quest:5152:obj:0: Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.
rows.quest:5152:details:0: Oh, I'm so lonely! Where is my family? ⟦E35⟧ told me to stay here, but then she left and never came back! And my dad... have you seen him?
rows.quest:5152:details:1: Maybe ⟦E35⟧ knows where he is. She lives near Andorhal, in a house to the south. I think it was on a hill... she said it was on a hill.
rows.quest:5152:details:2: Please, ⟦49⟧. You're my new friend! Will you talk to my Auntie for me?
rows.quest:5152:completion:0: You saw Pamela? How is she? Is she alive?? Oh, no! Poor Pamela! She was so young, and such a happy child...
rows.quest:5152:completion:1: She doesn't know what happened to her father, does she? My brother, ⟦E36⟧?
rows.quest:5152:completion:2: No... she couldn't understand what happened to ⟦E36⟧. And even if she could, I don't have the heart to tell her...
rows.quest:5153:details:0: I wish ⟦E36⟧ could again be with his daughter, but it cannot be so. His soul was twisted by the Scourge, and he became a monster. Oh, he is doomed!
rows.quest:5153:details:1: But perhaps we can change his fate.
rows.quest:5153:details:2: Search the graves outside for ⟦E36⟧'s monument. His body's not there, for it was trampled and destroyed years ago, but under the monument is his wedding ring. Take that ring to Chromie... a strange gnome with very strange powers.
rows.quest:5153:details:3: Chromie is staying in the ruined inn at the northwest corner of Andorhal.
rows.quest:5153:progress:0: There is something timely about your visit. You're not from the future, are you?
rows.quest:5153:completion:0: What is this? A wedding ring? Let me see...
rows.quest:5153:completion:1: Ah! This ring was once on the hand of a great man, but there is much tragedy in that man's past.
rows.quest:5153:completion:2: Are you here to help him? It's far too late for him now... but perhaps we can help him in the past!
rows.quest:5168:details:0: The heroes of Darrowshire hold a place in my heart, and the book you brought me, the ⟦E40⟧, tells their tales.
rows.quest:5168:details:1: It tells of the paladin Davil Lightfire and how the Crusade took his libram to the town hall of Hearthglen.
rows.quest:5168:details:2: Its passages also speak of my brother, Captain Redpath. After his betrayal, his shield was cracked and discarded and now lies in the most unlikely of places -- near the barn of Gahrron's Withering.
rows.quest:5168:details:3: Gather these relics, ⟦50⟧. For fate and tragedy surrounds them.
rows.quest:5168:completion:0: You have the libram and the shield!
rows.quest:5168:completion:1: Their history is entwined with the history of Darrowshire, and somehow, I know that fate will bring them together again.
rows.quest:5210:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E41⟧ to Carlin Redpath in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:5210:details:0: ⟦E42⟧, through my magic, has gained pages at its end, and now it extends its history beyond the ⟦E12⟧. One of the extra passages tells of another Redpath, Carlin, who survived ⟦E36⟧'s betrayal. Carlin's now in the ⟦E6⟧ to the east, at the ⟦E20⟧.
rows.quest:5210:details:1: Take the book and speak with him.
rows.quest:5210:progress:0: You've come from the west? How fare the rest of Lordaeron? I know that Andorhal is lost, but has the Scourge yet reached fair Tirisfal?
rows.quest:5210:completion:0: What is this book? ⟦E42⟧? That was my home before the war... my home before the ⟦E12⟧ that destroyed it! Why did you bring me this book?
rows.quest:5210:completion:1: But look here! At the end there are pages that tell tales of the days beyond the ⟦E12⟧! Here is a passage about me! And one about my brother ⟦E36⟧! Is this book true?
rows.quest:5241:details:0: Sometimes, when it's nighttime, I can hear my ⟦E43⟧ crying. It sounds like he's far away, to the east.
rows.quest:5241:details:1: I hope he's not crying for me! ⟦52⟧, will you find my uncle and tell him I'm alright?
rows.quest:5241:details:2: If you find him say I'm waiting for him, and I want to hear the story he used to tell... the one about the rabbits and the berry jam! That story's so funny!
rows.quest:5241:completion:1: She's dead? No! Oh, Pamela! Why does your spirit still suffer in this world. Why are you perished, while fortune keeps me alive? In an instant I would switch places with you and wander dead Darrowshire, a ghost and alone!
rows.quest:5241:completion:2: Ah, but this news cannot change fate. Thank you, ⟦53⟧. Now my duty, my duty to revenge, burns hot as ever.
